name: SEO Text Block
description: A content component that displays a title and body text, allowing custom alignment and styling

attribute_definitions.name: Text Container Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to the text container to adjust spacing, alignment, or styling of the content. e.g. 'p-2'. See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Title Heading Tag
attribute_definitions.description: Specifies the HTML heading tag (h2–h4) to be used for the title.Defaults to 'h2'

attribute_definitions.name: Body Text Alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Body text alignment, default is left
